node_name: Native CSS parameterized high-density branch and join
status_scope: EOS-06 native CSS parameterized high-density branch and join contract (the 6 acceptance criteria) on the benchmark GPPVA_FSU2H crust + GM_GM1 core + Alford-Han-Prakash conformal first-order CSS segment. The analytic CSS kernel (compose_eos_css.f90) already existed and passed CI (M5A / E390-05A); this node closes the PARTIAL_NATIVE_KERNEL_JOIN_NOT_RUN remainder by adding the join subroutine (compose_eos_css_join.f90), the 'css-join' CLI action, the source-backed parameter manifest (eos390_css_segments.v1.json), the Python API (join_crust_core_css), and verification tests for all 6 criteria. The joined crust+core+CSS table is NOT sidecar-only, the Delta_epsilon first-law jump is verified at machine precision, the assembled sound speed is causal across the whole join, and the joined table is written to a CompOSE dir and read back losslessly. NOT a 390-batch PASS (EOS-07), NOT a complete-EOS PASS for the 6 EOS-03 source-blocked models (their CSS branches remain out of scope), NOT a Dropbox upload PASS.
dependency_note: EOS-03 is PASS_OR_BLOCKED_SCOPED (6 resolved models usable, 6 source-blocked); EOS-04 is PASS. The CSS join uses the EOS-04 match_crust_core output (matched crust+core table) as its base and the EOS-03-resolved core model (GM_GM1) for the benchmark. The 6 EOS-03 source-blocked models (GPPVA_FSU2/FSU2H/NL3wrL55/TM1e Walecca-blocked, SPG_M3/M5 posterior-extreme) are NOT in the EOS-06 PASS scope: their CSS branches remain out of scope until EOS-03's blocks are lifted (Lalazissis 1997 PDF; posterior-fit-J acceptance). The CSS parameter manifest documents these as blocked_segments.

css_join_architecture.analytic_kernel: fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_css.f90 (pre-existing, M5A CI-pass): css_segment_t, initialize_css_segment (verifies Delta_epsilon = mu_t * Delta_n_B jump identity, residual < 64*eps*scale; sets interface_class = first_order when delta_epsilon>0), evaluate_css_segment (high-phase epsilon(P)=epsilon_high+(P-P_t)/cs2, nb(P)=nb_high*factor^(1/(1+cs2)), mu_B=(epsilon+P)/nb; rejects acausal cs2<=0 and cs2>1).
css_join_architecture.join_subroutine: fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_css_join.f90 join_crust_core_css: takes a matched crust+core EOSData + CSS params (p_transition, epsilon_low, nb_low, delta_epsilon, cs2, n_css), initializes the css_segment_t (verifies the jump), samples a high-density pressure grid strictly above the matched table's top knot, evaluates epsilon(P)/nb(P)/mu_B(P), converts to CompOSE Q1-Q7 (code convention P=q1*nb, mu_B=(q3+1)*mn, F=(q6+1)*mn, energy=nb*(q7+1)*mn), assembles the joined table (matched knots verbatim + CSS tail), asserts strictly-increasing nb+P, asserts the first law mu_B=F+P/nb on every row, computes the finite-difference sound speed and asserts 0<cs2<=1.
css_join_architecture.cli_action: fortran_eos/app/compose_eos_fortran.f90 case('css-join') (8 args: MATCHED_INTERNAL OUTPUT_INTERNAL P_TRANSITION EPSILON_LOW NB_LOW DELTA_EPSILON CS2 N_CSS): reads the matched internal CSV, calls join_crust_core_css, writes the joined internal CSV + metadata, emits a JSON report with n_matched/n_css/n_total/interface_class/jump_verified/causal/pressure_strictly_increasing.
css_join_architecture.python_api: python_frontend/compose_eos/api.py join_crust_core_css: validates the CSS params, calls the native css-join action via run_native, reads the joined EOSData from the internal dir, computes the native consistency record, returns (joined, info).
css_join_architecture.parameter_manifest: data/eos390_css_segments.v1.json: schema ns-cowling.eos390-css-segments, reference Alford-Han-Prakash PRD 88 083013 (2013) arXiv:1302.4732, one source-backed segment (benchmark_conformal_first_order: p_transition=712.78, epsilon_low=1397.11, nb_low=1.0, delta_epsilon=698.55, cs2=1/3, n_css=8, interface_class=first_order) + a blocked_segments list (the 6 EOS-03 source-blocked models).

acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence_detail: data/eos390_css_segments.v1.json exists, schema ns-cowling.eos390-css-segments, reference cites Alford-Han-Prakash PRD 88 083013 (2013) arXiv:1302.4732, the benchmark_conformal_first_order segment carries all 5 CSS params (p_transition, epsilon_low, nb_low, delta_epsilon, cs2) + n_css + interface_class=first_order, and the blocked_segments list documents the 6 EOS-03 source-blocked models that are out of scope.

The 'css-join' action is in the CLI usage string (compose_eos_fortran.f90 case('css-join')). join_crust_core_css (api.py) calls run_native('css-join', ...) and returns a joined EOSData + report. The 9 new EOS-06 tests all exercise this path.

The joined EOSData has n_total = n_matched + n_css (609 + 8 = 617 rows). The CSS tail knots (rows n_matched+1..n_total) have nb strictly greater than the matched core top (1.0 -> 7.56 fm^-3). The joined nb grid is strictly increasing. The CSS tail is INLINE in the main EOSData (not a sidecar file): composition is absent (strict-thermo-only) but the thermo rows (nb, Q1..Q7) include the CSS tail in the single array. The write_compose round-trip writes a full CompOSE dir (eos.nb, eos.t, eos.thermo, eos.yq), not a CSS-only sidecar.

The kernel's jump identity Delta_epsilon = mu_t * Delta_n_B is verified at machine precision (first_law_jump_residual = 4.88e-16, < 64*eps*scale). interface_class = 1 (first_order, delta_epsilon > 0). epsilon_high = epsilon_low + delta_epsilon. nb_high > nb_low (the jump increases density). On the joined table, the first law mu_B = F + P/nb holds at every row (max residual < 1e-3 relative).

The finite-difference joined sound speed is causal: cs2_min = 3.8e-5 (low-density crust), cs2_max = 0.756 (CSS branch), all within (0, 1]. The joined table passes the native C1-C11 consistency gate: overall PASS, C6 (dP/dn_B > 0) PASS, C10 (causal sound speed) PASS, C11 (dmu_B/dn_B > 0) PASS.

The joined table is written to a CompOSE directory (eos.nb, eos.t, eos.thermo, eos.yq -- a full CompOSE table) and read back via read_compose: row count matches (617), density grid matches to rtol=1e-12, the CSS high-density tail survives (max nb = 7.56 fm^-3 > 1.3), and the first-law identity holds on the read-back table. This is the native read-back guarantee.

honesty_note: G3 produced one failing-first diagnostic during the implementation: the first css-join CLI run failed with 'joined EOS pressure grid is not strictly increasing'. Root cause was a unit-convention bug in the Q1 assignment (I set q1 = p_grid/mn^2 but the code convention is P = q1*nb, so q1 = P/nb). Corrected by reading eos_pressure/eos_mu_b/eos_free_energy/eos_energy in compose_eos_types.f90 and setting q1 = p_grid(k)/nb_css(k). The corrected run produced the joined table with jump_verified=true, causal=true, pressure_strictly_increasing=true. This was a genuine implementation bug (not test-side), found and fixed before the verification tests were run. The Fortran executable SHA changed (f0acd9e1 -> 9f3a9a8a) reflecting the new module + CLI case.
